jezero.period: mean over a Mars year, measured by the Perseverance rover

source.name: NASA Perseverance MEDA ground temperature, Planetary Data System

jezero.method: Our own average of the MEDA TIRS ground brightness temperature: two consecutive sols sampled every 20 sols over sols 30-670, 29 days with near-complete coverage. Min and max are the average coldest and warmest half hour of the day.

gale.period: mean over a Mars year, measured by the Curiosity rover

source.name: NASA Curiosity REMS ground temperature, Planetary Data System

gale.method: Our own average of the REMS ground brightness temperature: one sol sampled every 40 sols over sols 21-660, 15 days with full coverage, in hourly bins. Hourly bins smooth the midday peak, so the max is probably a few degrees low.

arcadia.period: mean over a Mars year, from a climate model

source.name: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (a model, not a NASA measurement)

arcadia.method: Surface temperature from the LMD Mars Climate Database at 49.0 N, 171.85 W, time-weighted over its 24 seasons and 24 hours. No lander has measured this site.
